description: This file contains test cases for the Website Content functionality within the sales manager application. It defines a test class extending a core test case, with methods to test creating content pages and content boxes, utilizing services such as ContentService, languageService, countryService, zoneService, and merchantService.

classes.name: WebsiteContentTestCase
classes.description: A JUnit test class designed to test content-related functions of the website, including content page and box creation, using dependency-injected services.

methods.name: testCreateContentPage
methods.description: Test method to create a content page, retrieves language, country, zone, and store information, and calls the ContentService to perform operations (not fully implemented).

methods.name: testCreateContentBox
methods.description: Test method to create a content box, retrieves language, country, zone, and store information similar to the above method (not fully implemented).
